summary: @onereach/si-radio-group ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a pinned Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and uses it to execute `math_init.js`, a ~727KB heavily obfuscated single-line bundle (rotated string-array with push/shift scaffolding, hex-named identifiers, encoded char-code table). The package advertises itself as a Vue radio-group UI component and its `package.json` declares `module: lib/component.js` with `files: [lib/*]`; the top-level `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are unrelated to that advertised purpose and are not needed by the library's runtime. Using a fetched alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling file evades Node-based inspection, and the obfuscated payload — whose behavior is opaque — runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
